reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: deposit_limit_breached is called from market.move:278 (non-test). Gate 2: entry point is the public deposit function (untrusted caller, no trust_assumptions field in scope). Gate 3: reserve.move is in-scope. Code confirmed: exchange_rate() uses cash_plus_borrows_minus_reserves() = cash+debt-cash_reserve, so total_deposit_plus_interest already excludes cash_reserve; the check at L89 subtracts cash_reserve a second time, making the effective supply cap = supply_cap + cash_reserve. An attacker can trigger this via the public deposit entry point by depositing until total deposits reach supply_cap + cash_reserve, bypassing the intended supply cap by up to the accumulated protocol reserve balance.
